description: This file defines a custom exception class `AttendanceServiceException` for the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin, providing static methods to generate specific exception instances related to attendance punch-in/out logic and validation errors.

classes.name: AttendanceServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's built-in Exception, providing factory methods for specific attendance-related error conditions.

methods.name: punchOutAlreadyExist
methods.description: Returns an instance of AttendanceServiceException indicating that the punch-out process cannot proceed because the employee has already punched out.

methods.name: punchInAlreadyExist
methods.description: Returns an instance indicating the employee has already punched in and cannot punch in again.

methods.name: punchOutTimeBehindThanPunchInTime
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating the punch-out time must be later than the punch-in time.

methods.name: punchInOverlapFound
methods.description: Returns an exception when a punch-in overlap is detected.

methods.name: punchOutOverlapFound
methods.description: Returns an exception when a punch-out overlap is detected.

methods.name: invalidDateTime
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating provided date and time are invalid.

methods.name: punchOutDateTimeNull
methods.description: Returns an exception when punch-out date/time is null.

methods.name: deletableAttendanceRecordIdsEmpty
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating no IDs were provided for deletion.

methods.name: invalidTimezoneDetails
methods.description: Returns an exception when timezone details are invalid or missing.
